data.desc: Butterfly Network, Inc. (NYSE: BFLY) is driving a digital revolution in ultrasound imaging and sensing with its proprietary Ultrasound-on-Chip semiconductor technology and software solutions. Butterfly first proved its technology in the point-of-care ultrasound market - commercializing the world's first single-probe, whole-body portable ultrasound device, which is now on its best-selling, third-generation: Butterfly iQ3. The Company combines its advanced hardware with cloud software and AI, an enterprise workflow solution (Compass AI) and other offerings to drive adoption of affordable, accessible ultrasound. Butterfly also enables third-party development of imaging AI apps through Butterfly Garden, its software development kit and AI marketplace.
